Done. `cat -A` confirms:
- `Payments Team  $` — two trailing spaces
- `Building 4, Floor 2  $` — two trailing spaces
- `payments@example.com$` — unchanged, no trailing spaces
Note: this intentionally reverses the earlier "no trailing whitespace" constraint, since Markdown only renders a hard line break with two trailing spaces.
